output_text:
```python
import os
from google.cloud import documentai
from google.cloud.documentai_v1.types import document

def validate_structured_document_fields(file_path, project_id, location, processor_id):
    os.environ["GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"] = "path/to/your/credentials.json"
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()

    # Specify the processor to be used
    name = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor_id}"

    # Read the file into memory
    with open(file_path, "rb") as image:
        image_content = image.read()

    # Create the Document object
    document_request = document.Document(
        content=image_content,
        mime_type="application/pdf",
    )

    # Process the document
    response = client.process_document(name=name, document=document_request)

    # Extract entities from the response
    entities = response.entities

    required_fields = ["vendor_name", "total_amount", "invoice_date"]
    validated_fields = {}

    for entity in entities:
        if entity.type_.value in required_fields:
            if entity.confidence < 0.5:
                return False, f"Field {entity.type_.value} has low confidence"
            validated_fields[entity.type_.value] = entity.text

    if set(required_fields).issubset(validated_fields.keys()):
        return True, validated_fields
    else:
        return False, "Missing required fields"
```
